name: 莉萨·钱布利斯
name_full: 莉萨·钱布利斯 Lisa Chambliss
introduction: Lisa Chambliss is a SAG-AFTRA actress, producer, recording artist, writer and entrepreneur whose multifaceted career spans film, television, music, and fashion. She is recognized for her performances in Magic Max, The Glue That Binds Us, and Kingdom of Sin, where she brings emotional depth and dynamic versatility to every role. Under the moniker L.A. Bliss, Lisa has independently written, recorded, and produced a catalog of pop music that draws on nostalgic '80s influences. She also directs and produces all her own music videos, creating visually rich storytelling experiences that complement her sound. As a television and film producer, Lisa recently joined Bonfire Entertainment, where she continues to expand her creative impact across scripted and unscripted content. Her foundation in the performing arts-beginning at the age of four-includes extensive training in dance, voice, and improvisation, shaping her adaptive and expressive approach to each project. Lisa holds a degree in Interior Design from Florida State University and is the founder of Purr Glam, a sustainable lingerie brand that supports animal welfare initiatives. She divides her time between Los Angeles and Nashville, continuing to evolve as a multi-hyphenate creator in front of and behind the camera.
